infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: ShotTrax captures GPS when you confirm a club to start a shot, and again on the next mark to measure yards.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: ShotTrax uses the microphone only when you tap Say a club so you can name a club like “seven iron”. You still confirm before the shot is marked. Watch and mic shot-detect assists are not in this build.
infoPlist.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: ShotTrax uses speech recognition to match what you say to a club in your bag. You still confirm before the shot is marked.
